Problem seems to be that `do_helptags(dirname,...)` (only?) frees `dirname` on error. But the calling function is not informed about this.
I'd like to make a PR of the fix.

issue.title: [RDY] helptags: fix double-free bug

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body: This should fix bug #7599 as `ex_helptags` always calls `xfree(dirname)` after calling `do_helptags`.
